newsitem.title: USA: Ford Division US March sales seen flat, down.
newsitem.headline: Ford Division US March sales seen flat, down.

text.p: Ford Motor Co's Ford Divison is expected to show flat March sales in the United States or a slight decline compared with the same month last year, General Manager Ross Roberts said on Thursday.

Roberts, speaking to reporters at the New York International Auto Show, said the division's car business was soft this month, even though sales were picking up recently. He said car sales would likely show a decline from year-ago levels.
March sales of light trucks, including pickup trucks, sport utility vehicles and minivans, will rise, surpassing the record 190,000 light truck vehicles sold in March 1996, he said.
"We set an all-time record last year with number, and right now we're on pace to break that," said Roberts.
